comment: Every repo that vendors this kit, relative to the kit root. The kit's own `npm run check` verifies each one it can find is still in sync — that is what catches an edit made HERE and never synced OUT, which is the drift the consumers cannot detect for themselves. A path that does not exist is skipped and reported, not failed, so the suite still passes on a machine that has only some of these checked out. Add a line when you stamp a new app.
